comment: The inverter output writes 5V rather than the 10V the three logic outputs use (LogProb.cpp:89). The two coin-toss results are single booleans shared by every channel (LogProb.cpp:32-33), so under polyphony the last channel's toss decides the result for all of them. The toss is taken by a BooleanTrigger fed the raw voltage (LogProb.cpp:60, 69), which counts any voltage other than zero as high, while the logic itself reads a gate as high only above 1V.
